title: 找到指定长度的回文数
summary: 对每个查询 k，返回按升序排列的第 k 个指定长度回文数，不存在则负一。
insight: 回文数由前半部分唯一决定。长度 half=(L+1)/2 的最小前半是 10^(half-1)，第 k 个前半加 k-1，再把其适当反转拼接。
pitfalls: 偶数长度镜像整个前半，奇数长度跳过中间位

solutions.title: 按前半部分编号构造
solutions.idea: 把回文数序列映射到连续前半整数。
steps: 对 query：offset=query-1，超 limit 返回 -1
half=start+offset；result=half，mirror=奇数时 half/10 否则 half；逐位追加 mirror%10

code.java: class Solution { public long[] kthPalindrome(int[] queries,int intLength){int halfLength=(intLength+1)/2;long start=1;for(int i=1;i<halfLength;i++)start*=10;long limit=9*start;long[] answer=new long[queries.length];for(int i=0;i<queries.length;i++){long offset=queries[i]-1L;if(offset>=limit){answer[i]=-1;continue;}long half=start+offset,result=half,mirror=intLength%2==1?half/10:half;while(mirror>0){result=result*10+mirror%10;mirror/=10;}answer[i]=result;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun kthPalindrome(queries:IntArray,intLength:Int):LongArray{val halfLength=(intLength+1)/2;var start=1L;repeat(halfLength-1){start*=10};val limit=9*start;return LongArray(queries.size){i->val offset=queries[i]-1L;if(offset>=limit)-1L else{val half=start+offset;var result=half;var mirror=if(intLength%2==1)half/10 else half;while(mirror>0){result=result*10+mirror%10;mirror/=10};result}}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<long long> kthPalindrome(vector<int>& queries,int intLength){int halfLength=(intLength+1)/2;long long start=1;for(int i=1;i<halfLength;++i)start*=10;long long limit=9*start;vector<long long> answer;for(int query:queries){long long offset=query-1;if(offset>=limit){answer.push_back(-1);continue;}long long half=start+offset,result=half,mirror=intLength%2?half/10:half;while(mirror){result=result*10+mirror%10;mirror/=10;}answer.push_back(result);}return answer;} };
